scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 database for OAuth tokens, devices, grants, and audit metadata (auto-provisioned).

DEVICE_ROOM.description: Durable Object namespace for per-device hibernatable WebSocket rooms.

OAUTH_ISSUER.description: Optional canonical issuer URL. Defaults to the Worker request origin.

SESSION_SECRET.description: Required signing secret. Generate with at least 32 random bytes.

OWNER_TOKEN_HASH.description: SHA-256 of the one-time owner passkey bootstrap code. Store only as a Wrangler secret.

AUTH_PROVIDER.description: Optional external identity service for multi-user deployments. Built-in single-owner auth is the default.

OWNMESH_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS.description: Explicit local/test-only bypass. Must remain false in production.
